description: This file contains unit tests for the HierarchicalKeyStore class, testing functionalities such as key creation, read/write operations, delete, partial key read, and handling of non-existent keys within a hierarchical storage context.

classes.name: HierarchicalKeyStoreTests
classes.description: Unit test class for hierarchical key-value store operations, implementing various test cases for CRUD operations and key management.

classes.name: HierarchicalKeyStoreTests.Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class for initializing shared context or resources for HierarchicalKeyStoreTests.

methods.name: HKS_MakeKey
methods.description: Tests the static method MakeStoreKey to generate a hierarchical key string from a list of key-value pairs.

methods.name: HKS_1Key_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a single key-value pair in the hierarchical store.

methods.name: HKS_2Key_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests writing and reading with two hierarchical keys.

methods.name: HKS_3Key_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests writing and reading with three hierarchical keys.

methods.name: HKS_Write2
methods.description: Tests overwriting data at a given key with new data and verifying the update.

methods.name: HKS_DeleteRow
methods.description: Tests deleting a row based on hierarchical keys and verifying that data is cleared or removed.

methods.name: HKS_Read_PartialKey
methods.description: Tests reading data using a subset of the hierarchical key (partial key) and retrieving matching entries.

methods.name: HKS_KeyNotFound
methods.description: Checks the response when attempting to read data for a non-existent key, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: MakeKeys
methods.description: Utility method to create a list of key-value tuple pairs for testing.
